meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 它会扫描当前仓库所有未关闭的 issue 和 pull request，逐个生成分析报告写入 /tmp 日期目录；报告中每条结论都附 GitHub 专属链接作证据。它只读不改，绝不在 GitHub 上评论、合并、关闭或打标签。
howto.when: 当你使用“triage”“triage issues”“triage PRs”“github triage”等触发词时触发；会分析仓库全部未关闭的 issue 和 PR。

say.note: 分析当前仓库全部未关闭 issue 和 PR
只分析未关闭的 pull request

howto.what_en: Scans all open issues and PRs in the repo, analyzes each, and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}; every claim requires a GitHub permalink. Read-only: never comments, merges, closes, or labels on GitHub.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', or 'github triage'. It analyzes every open item, so use when you need a full read-only review of the backlog.

say_en.note: Analyzes all open issues and PRs
